note: Small Alberta Parks campground near the Clearwater River, 65 km southwest of Rocky Mountain House on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 734), maintained by the Friends of the Eastern Slopes Association. Pack out garbage and bring toilet paper and drinking water; collecting deadfall for firewood is prohibited. OHVs are allowed but must stay on the recreation area's roads. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Oct 28, 2026) and FOESA's page: free (FOESA membership encouraged), year-round, first-come only, unserviced, vault toilets, pump water not guaranteed; sites 13 -> 15. Phone 403-304-0456 suggested. Not waterfront kept (Elk Creek ~35-55 m from the loop's west side across meadow: lead only).
